prompt: Goal: make benzyl ethyl ether (PhCH₂-O-CH₂CH₃) from benzyl alcohol. The CLEAN route is:

options.label: PhCH₂OH + NaH → alkoxide; then + EtBr (Williamson, SN2 on 1° halide)
PhCH₂OH + EtOH + H₂SO₄, heat (acid-catalyzed condensation of two alcohols)
PhCH₂OH + EtCl, pyridine (pyridine helps displace Cl via SN2)

explanation: Williamson is clean when the alkyl halide is primary (benzyl alcohol → alkoxide + EtBr). Acid condensation would give symmetric and mixed ethers + alkenes — messy. Alkoxymercuration adds to alkenes, not alcohols. EtCl is poorly reactive and pyridine doesn't make 1° alcohols nucleophilic enough on their own.
